as_told.title: Trump told about hybrids in UFO briefing

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines says he believes Donald Trump has been briefed on parts of "legacy programs," meaning long-running secret efforts said to deal with unexplained craft, and that Trump knows at least the broad outline that the subject is real. A guest named Eric Burles, passing on what he was told, says the briefing told Trump there are hybrids, beings that are part human and part not. According to Burles, Trump answered, "You mean like Adam Schiff," naming a congressman from the other party. People tell it because it would mean a president was let in on the secret.
